cn.title: 船只养成手册 奖励补发
cn.body:
亲爱的舰长：

由于活动周期设置问题，您购买的「船只养成手册」有部分每日奖励未能正常领取。

我们已逐一核对您的实际领取记录，现将未领取的部分一次性补发至本邮件附件，请及时领取。

给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意，感谢您一直以来的支持！

en.title: Ship Cultivation Handbook - Reward Compensation
en.body:
Dear Captain,

Due to an issue with the activity cycle settings, some of the daily rewards from your Ship Cultivation Handbook could not be claimed in time.

We have reviewed each player's claim record individually, and the unclaimed rewards are attached to this mail. Please claim them promptly.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your continued support.
